item.title: Kenneth Walker: Set to log 'DNP' on Wednesday
item.description:
Walker (groin) won't practice Wednesday, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

item.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Deemed 100 percent ahead of likely release
item.description:
Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Dontayvion Wicks: Could be back this week
item.description:
Coach Nick Sirianni relayed Wednesday that he feels good about the chances of Wicks (ankle) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jalon Daniels: Getting first-team reps Wednesday
item.description:
Daniels is slated to take all of the first-teams reps Wednesday with Baker Mayfield (foot) sidelined for the Buccaneers' first Week 11 practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

item.title: DeVonta Smith: Trending toward being back this week
item.description:
Coach Nick Sirianni indicated Wednesday that he feels good about Smith (hamstring) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.
